text:
kevin: Kickoff for llm-serving v5 canary in 5m. Plan: 3% canary -> 20% -> 80% over ~35m. Health gates: p95 +120ms, error rate +1.5% abs, model error count >50 in 5m. Quiet window avoided.

tara: thanks. adding oncall. Please include warmup job this time; last time cold starts tripped latency.

kevin: yes, warmup job will run 6m before canary and TTL=12m. Commands below.

```
# warmup job for v5
infractl run warmup --model=llm-v5 --cohort=canary --ttl=12m
# set canary 3%
ffctl set llm-serving_v5 --cohort=canary --pct=3 --by=version
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Warmup job scheduled (start in 4m). Canary pending.

oncall-bot: NOTE: warmup job completed; cache hits 98% for sample traces.

kevin: starting canary now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary applied 1: 3% to cohort=canary (6599994321).

tara: watching metrics. p50/p95/p99 on canary: 30ms / 60ms / 140ms. Error rate 0.01%.

ops-roster: FYI running lightweight perf harness against long-context cases in parallel.

oncall-bot: ALERT: p95 on canary increased to 205ms (threshold exceeded) 1m ago.

kevin: hold ramp. pausing any scheduled move to 20%.

tara: confirm hold. investigating traces now.

ops-roster: trace sample shows a batch of long-context requests routed to canary causing KV-cache thrash. Warmup didn't cover those samples.

kevin: given p95>threshold and concentrated pattern, execute fast rollback for canary to 0% and pin default to v4.8.

```
# rollback commands
ffctl set llm-serving_v5 --cohort=canary --pct=0
ffctl pin llm-serving --version=v4.8 --cohort=default --reason="canary_p95_spike"
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback executed 1: v5 removed from canary, v4.8 pinned for default (6599994380). Audit logged.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT: https://go.redwood/incident/1201 created for canary p95 spike and rollback.

tara: metrics back to baseline within 45s post-rollback. Will update release notes with steps: narrower initial cohort, include long-context warmup samples, and increase warmup TTL.

kevin: agreed. will open a follow-up PR with updated rollout script and add a traffic-sample job to the warmup. Thanks all, closing thread.
